versions.changelog:
wechat-local-reader version 1.0.1

- Initial release of wechat-local-reader: a local tool to read, decrypt, and desensitize your own desktop WeChat database, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- Provides command-line access to chats, contacts, groups, and public accounts, with built-in masking of sensitive info (phone, ID, bank card, email).
- Generates work summaries and pushes them to email, WeCom, or any HTTP endpoint, all locally with zero data upload for privacy.
- Supports scheduled automation through WorkBuddy for daily/periodic summaries.
- Windows 4.1+ key extraction is based on open source project TANGandXUE/wcdb-key-tool (MIT), with author attribution.
- Strictly limited to personal use—can only be used to read the user’s own WeChat data on their own computer. Not for mobile devices.
